current_text.html: The Church should maintain constant and sympathetic relations with the children. It also should encourage them, on coming to years of discretion, to make confession of the Lord Jesus Christ and to enter upon all privileges of full church membership. If they are wayward they should be cherished by the church and every means used to reclaim them.

relationships.title: Responsibility of the Session to Examine Children for Membership

occurrences.excerpt: The CCB advised that sessions should give appropriate deference to prior admission decisions of other PCA sessions unless compelling reasons exist to do otherwise.

metadata.synopsis: The SJC sustained Psiaki’s complaint and held that the CPC Session erred by ordaining and installing officers elected at a February 5, 2023 congregational meeting where the congregation’s bylaw excluded communing members under 18 from voting. Reading BCO 6-4, 25-1, and 25-7 together, the SJC ruled that all communing members are entitled to vote and that local bylaws cannot impose an age restriction; the “good and regular standing” language addresses censure, not age. The decision did not annul the completed ordination/installation, but required future elections and installations to comply with the Constitution.
